article.headline: Mason Falslev totals 33 points, 12 rebounds to lead Utah State past UC San Diego 120-82
article.description: — Mason Falslev finished with 33 points and 12 rebounds to power Utah State to a 120-82 victory over UC San Diego on Friday night.
article.linkText: Mason Falslev totals 33 points, 12 rebounds to lead Utah State past UC San Diego 120-82

article.story: LOGAN, Utah -- — Mason Falslev finished with 33 points and 12 rebounds to power Utah State to a 120-82 victory over UC San Diego on Friday night. Solomon Callaghan hit five 3-pointers and scored 22 for the Aggies (4-0). Karson Templin had 16 points. Treysen Eaglestaff finished with 16 points for the Tritons (2-1). Leo Beath had 15 points and Rahmir Barno contributed 10 points and five assists. Falslev had 18 points by halftime to help Utah State build a 73-34 advantage. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
